sites.name: His Finished Work
sites.tagline: The best is yet to come.
sites.description:
The story of what is happening behind the scenes of Creation - from Genesis to Revelation.

Understand passages there were a little strange instead of passing over them.  You will see and understand the bible like you never did before.

As you read this story, the Word of God will open up next to it with a single click or tap.
contents: 5. Son of God and of Man
